blind.description: A stylized freestanding upright wooden ladder featuring two vertical side rails with rounded finial-style caps and seven horizontal cylindrical rungs. The top and bottom rungs extend through the outer sides of the rails, terminating in visible round pegs. The surfaces are smooth, manifold, and finished with a warm honey-brown wood texture.
blind.from_above: A horizontal crossbar spanning two rounded rail tops with small circular peg extensions on the outer ends, resembling a slender dumbbell or capped rung.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 7.5 to 8 feet tall (taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
